_extraction_flags.notes: Valid O-ISAC paper! Full-duplex microwave photonics ISAC with CO-RAU-MS architecture. Carrier reuse: PM for downlink, IM for uplink.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Fig.1: Full-duplex system with CO, RAU, MS. WDM + PM/IM modulation. Fig.2: E-band spectrum allocation. Fig.3-5: OptiSystem simulation results. Fig.6-7: Experimental setup and ISAC results (2D map, constellations).
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Microwave photonics full-duplex ISAC. Key innovation: optical carrier reuse - PM for downlink (13-18 GHz IF → 81-86 GHz), IM for uplink (71-76 GHz → 3-8 GHz IF). FDM separates radar echo from uplink comm. Single fiber bidirectional. WDM for phased array beamforming.
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Comm: 600 Mbps QPSK-LFM, EVM 9.43% (DL) / 20.72% (UL). Radar: 1.5 cm distance resolution, Range-Doppler map at 1.9 m. 5 GHz bandwidth per link. Simulation: OptiSystem15, 4-channel WDM.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: Full-duplex ISAC with carrier reuse. Reduces cost and complexity. First bidirectional fiber ISAC with FDM separation. Gap: Lab demo at microwave (12.8-13.1 GHz) not mmW (71-86 GHz). Slow target limited velocity resolution.

bibliographic.title: Full-duplex Integrated Sensing and Communication System Based on Microwave Photonics
bibliographic.authors: Weiqiong Wang, Guanxing Zhang, He Wen, Jie Zhang

application.scenario_description: Full-duplex RAN front-haul with simultaneous bidirectional communication and radar sensing for mobile stations.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Full-duplex ISAC with optical carrier reuse: phase modulation for downlink, intensity modulation for uplink. FDM separation of radar echo and uplink communication.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Previous ISAC systems lacked bidirectional (full-duplex) capability with carrier reuse.

transmitter.notes: 4-channel WDM (193.1, 193.3, 193.5, 193.7 THz). PM for downlink (π/2 modulation index). IM (MZM) for uplink. IF: 13-18 GHz DL, 3-8 GHz UL.

receiver.notes: PD + LNA + BPF. Band-stop filter for PM demodulation. Duplexer separates radar echo (13-18 GHz) from uplink (3-8 GHz).

integration.notes: Carrier reuse: same optical carrier for DL (PM) and UL (IM). Circular polarization for equal power split. PBS for polarization diversity at RAU.

waveform.notes: QPSK-LFM integrated waveform. 600 Mbps. Same waveform for comm (QPSK) and sensing (LFM chirp).

channel_wireless.notes: 0.5-5 m mobile station range in experiment. Target E-band (71-86 GHz). Demo at microwave (12.8-13.1 GHz).

comm_metrics.notes: 600 Mbps QPSK. DL EVM 9.43%, UL EVM 20.72% (higher due to UHF band noise). Full-duplex verified.

sensing_metrics.notes: 1.5 cm distance resolution (from 300 MHz BW). 2D Range-Doppler map. MS at 1.9 m detected. Velocity accuracy limited by slow target.

tradeoff.notes: FDM: DL 81-86 GHz, UL 71-76 GHz. Duplexer isolation 50 dB. IM3 suppression 23.4 dB.
